::: {.bs-page-shell}
::: {.bs-reading-column}
::: {.bs-editorial-lead}
Reusable classroom materials for students and teachers. Generated PDFs link directly to their canonical files at [andrewandrade.ca/assets](https://andrewandrade.ca/assets/), avoiding duplicate copies. Editable classroom resources and current TAS design-process examples link to their student-facing Google Docs in the [Teaching folder](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rWNYdJpppXTj5Oq_FO6mBqT-Ihee6b3S).
:::

The library intentionally links to **generic teaching materials, not student submissions or student copies**. **General** materials are broadly reusable across subjects and technology courses. **Well-Being** materials focus on identity, reflection, listening, goal setting, community, and related learning routines.
:::

Filters are saved in the page URL as you select them, so you can copy the address bar and send someone the same filtered view.
